title: Scenario library: the three control cards gain Chinese asks, three unanswerable questions each with answerable twins, and avg / max / min truths
body:
epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed child of #33595 (M3 row of its milestone table, Blocked-by M2, which closed 2026-11-16 with #33818). Maintainer, 2026-11-15 02:10Z: 「你建议的任务全部立卡，你负责开 devx 车道派发处理」; 08:36Z, on the epic seat's decision card "M2/M3 的行现在立卡吗?立了交给谁派发?": "立卡,留给本专题席位派发".

## Mechanism

The three control cards (`docs/qa/scenarios/crm_account_with_contacts.json`, `invoice_with_line_items.json`, `project_with_tasks.json`) carry English-only asks (0 `zh` of 8 / 9 / 8 questions), one unanswerable question each, and few field aggregates: crm has none, invoice one `avg`, project one `max`, no card a `min`. The schema already supports `avg` / `min` / `max` truths (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/schema.ts` `fieldAggregate`) and `--lang zh` (#33743) can now send Chinese.

## Why it matters

The cloud product is prompted in Chinese, and one unanswerable question per card cannot tell a model that declines wisely from one that declines everything. Paired answerable twins (the same shape over a field the app does have) separate the two. More aggregate kinds test more of the query surface.

## Done when

- Every card text the runner sends (`prompt.short` / `prompt.detailed`, `iterate.change`, each question's and operation's `ask`) has a `zh` beside its `en` on the three cards, so `--lang zh` runs them.
- Each card has three unanswerable questions, each with an answerable twin of the same shape; and at least one `avg`, one `max` and one `min` truth.
- The loader computes every new truth from the seed; `validate` and the existing card tests pass; the library's derived docs regenerate.
- The PR states which scorecards move (question counts change) so eval#1 re-baselines on purpose.

## Reader

The epic seat `epic:#33595#1` dispatches it to `os-dev` (`domain:devx`, `docs/qa/scenarios/**`). Card JSON only; no runner or scorer code.

Dedup: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue unanswerable twins scenario cards` → 1 hit (#33595, the parent).
